verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"What do you people mean by quoting this saying about the land of Israel: 'The parents eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?
As surely as I live," says the Lord GOD, "you will no longer quote this saying in Israel.
Look, every life belongs to me, the life of the parent as well as the life of the child. The person who sins is the one who will die.
Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is fair and right.
He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel for help. He does not commit adultery with his neighbor's wife or have sex with a woman during her period.
He does not mistreat anyone. He returns what was given to him as security for a loan. He does not steal. He gives food to the hungry and clothes to those who need them.
He does not lend money for interest or make a profit from loans. He refuses to do wrong and judges fairly between people.
He follows my rules and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous, and he will surely live," says the Lord GOD.
"But suppose he has a son who is violent and kills people, and who does any of these other things,
even though the father did none of them. The son eats at the mountain shrines and commits adultery with his neighbor's wife.
He mistreats the poor and needy. He steals. He does not return what was given as security. He looks to idols for help and does disgusting things.

He lends money for interest and makes a profit from loans. Should such a man live? No, he will not live! Because he has done all these disgusting things, he will surely die. He will be responsible for his own death.
But suppose this son has a son of his own who sees all the sins his father has done. He thinks about them and does not do the same things.
He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel for help. He does not commit adultery with his neighbor's wife.
He does not mistreat anyone or demand security for a loan. He does not steal. He gives food to the hungry and clothes to those who need them.
He refuses to harm the poor. He does not take interest or make a profit from loans. He keeps my laws and follows my rules. He will not die for his father's sin. He will surely live.
But his father will die for his own sin, because he cheated people, robbed his brother, and did what was wrong among his people.
Yet you ask, 'Why doesn't the son share the guilt of his father?' Because the son has done what is fair and right and has carefully kept all my rules, he will surely live.

The person who sins is the one who will die. A child will not be punished for the parent's sin, and a parent will not be punished for the child's sin. Righteous people will be rewarded for their own righteousness, and wicked people will be punished for their own wickedness.
But if wicked people turn away from all the sins they have committed, keep all my rules, and do what is fair and right, they will surely live. They will not die.
None of the wrongs they have done will be held against them. Because of the right things they have done, they will live.
Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked?" says the Lord GOD. "No, I would much rather they turn from their ways and live.

But if righteous people turn away from doing right and do wrong, the same disgusting things wicked people do, should they live? None of the right things they have done will be remembered. Because of their unfaithfulness and the sins they have committed, they will die.
Yet you say, 'The Lord's way is not fair.' Listen, people of Israel: Is my way unfair? Isn't it your ways that are unfair?
If righteous people turn away from doing right and do wrong, they will die for it. They will die because of the wrong they have done.
And if wicked people turn away from the wickedness they have committed and do what is fair and right, they will save their lives.
Because they thought it over and turned away from all the wrongs they had committed, they will surely live. They will not die.
Yet the people of Israel say, 'The Lord's way is not fair.' People of Israel, are my ways unfair? Isn't it your ways that are unfair?
So, people of Israel, I will judge each of you by your own ways," says the Lord GOD. "Turn back! Turn away from all your wrongs, so that sin will not bring you to ruin.
Throw away all the wrongs you have committed, and get yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, people of Israel?
For I take no pleasure in anyone's death," says the Lord GOD. "So turn back and live!
